text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the riverbank on the way home,
I was suddenly reminded of that puppy Air Groove had taken in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "When I asked how she was doing—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as for that puppy, I was granted special permission
to look after it in my dorm room.
The dorm mother also watches over it while I am away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She's a clever girl who doesn't cause any trouble. Once you scold her,
she'll never do it again. Seems she's quite a fast learner.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps you could learn a thing or two from them as well, hm?
Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's expression softens warmly
as she proudly talks about how clever the puppy is...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I was just about to go shopping for supplies for him...
Care to come along?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Air Groove!
And Air Groove's Trainer-san tooâª

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, you're here already?
That's unusual for someone as loose with time as you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Leave the puppy to me!
If Air Groove is the mama, then I'll be the papa!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Who are you calling Mom?! And you're not Dad either!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Honestly... I hear that same pun from my roommate Fine every day; I'm getting sick of it already!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? Already a rival!?
As expected of Fine, she's not to be underestimated...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever, let's go before I get a headache.
The shop is this way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them came to the pet supplies section.
Air Groove stopped in front of a shelf lined with dog toys.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Alright. Taiki, I'll borrow your wisdom right away.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course♪ The sheepdogs back home
were all my best friends.
Ask me anytheeng you want!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you have any input, speak up immediately.
Now, let us begin sorting through the "toys"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ha!! Hey, hey, heeey!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Air Groooove!
So big bone! What do you think~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What do you expect a puppy to do
with a bone bigger than your entire body?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our puppy toy selection
proceeded smoothly(?), leading to――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, Air Groove purchased a small rubber ball that could hold treats inside.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That big ball is really no good?
Truly? Hmmmmmm~...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Taiki... what is with this mysterious
faith you have in huge things...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still... there were parts that I found useful.
Allow me to thank you for that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hey, Air Groove!
Are you finished with your shopping already, YES?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Doggy snacks! Let's buy some treats too!
Jerky, biscuits, cakes...
There are so many kinds♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...When it comes to communication,
offering snacks is an effective method, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I am merely a temporary caretaker.
Allowing it to become overly attached would be..."
choice_data_list: It's important to make them happy, too.
I'd like to try eating that for a change, woof!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nice assist!
Just as expected of Air Groove's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, you're overthinking things way too much, YES.
Snacks are the secret ingredient to happiness!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"If we have that, Papi is happy!
And if Papi is happy, you're happy too!
It's all okay!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Every single one of you, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well... if it's just one,
it shouldn't have much of an impact on your health.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Air Groove giving in with a wry smile,
we bought extra dog treats.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Don't tell me you're trying to imitate that girl.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All right, I've had it, kneel right there!!
I'll shove the sheer gap in our very existence
right under your nose for eternity!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove!?
Calm down! Caaaalm down!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, yes! Such a cute
puppy would be even cuter with treats!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Imagine, Air Groove. Biscuits...
puppies dashing around... and a big smi~le...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Just to be clear, it's not like your ridiculous imitation actually moved my heart or anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I merely incorporated the opinion of Taiki,
who has experience raising a dog, that is all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, Air Groove bought her snacks
and headed home.
